name: Koyfin
description: Koyfin is a financial-data and analytics platform for researching global markets, companies, funds, economics, portfolios, transcripts, news, charts, screeners, and investment reports.
agentUseSummary: Koyfin is unavailable for Relay installation because Koyfin explicitly states that users may not obtain its data through an API due to restrictions imposed by its data providers. Relay mounts no tools, requests no Koyfin credentials, does not automate the website or apps, and does not turn Koyfin's limited interactive downloads or inbound custodian integrations into an unsupported developer surface.

blocked.label: Block unsupported Koyfin actions
blocked.description: Market data, prices, performance, technicals, fundamentals, estimates, valuation, economics, funds, portfolios, watchlists, screens, charts, transcripts, news, alerts, reports, account data, integrations, and other Koyfin reads or writes are unavailable without a provider-supported API contract.

blocked.label: Block automated exports and redistribution
blocked.description: Interactive table or chart downloads, report exports, bulk extraction, caching, persistence, retransmission, reprocessing, redistribution, derived substitutes, publishing, and external sharing are unavailable as an agent integration surface.

blocked.label: Block credentials and workaround access
blocked.description: Usernames, passwords, sessions, cookies, browser or mobile-app automation, HTML scraping, reverse-engineered or vulnerability-scope API endpoints, undocumented hosts, and raw browser or HTTP tools are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block inbound-integration substitution
blocked.description: Koyfin's Schwab, Altruist, TradePMR, Black Diamond, Interactive Brokers, Orion, Fidelity Wealthscape, and Addepar connections import customer data into Koyfin and do not authorize Relay to read Koyfin or the underlying custodians.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Koyfin actions are available without a supported public API and authorization contract.

runtimeSupport.description: No Koyfin wrapper is mounted because Koyfin explicitly disallows user API data access and its data licenses do not authorize a generic Relay connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Koyfin's official FAQ says it does not allow users to obtain data through an API because its upstream data providers restrict that use. Koyfin licenses professional financial data from multiple vendors, restricts some interactive downloads, prohibits retransmission or reprocessing of information, and prohibits credential sharing. Koyfin publishes no supported external developer API, OAuth flow, API-key programme, webhook contract, or Relay-authorized data license.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep Koyfin unpublished. Re-run full provider research only if Koyfin launches a supported external API and grants Relay and every applicable data licensor written rights covering cloud-agent access, authentication, permitted datasets, automated processing, transient display, retention, derived output, attribution, redistribution, rate limits, provider marks, and customer entitlements.

evidence.supports: Koyfin explicitly states that it does not allow users to obtain data through an API because of restrictions from its data providers.
Koyfin states that it buys data under license from more than a dozen vendors, including S&P Capital IQ, Morningstar, FRED, Trading Economics, True FX, and Polygon.
Koyfin documents limited interactive table and chart downloads while stating that global-equity financials, estimates, and valuation data are restricted from download by its data vendor.
Koyfin's published integrations are plan-gated inbound connections that import custodian and portfolio-management data into Koyfin Client Portfolios rather than an external Koyfin developer API.

Koyfin's subscriber terms prohibit retransmitting or reprocessing information, transmitting or publishing it to another person, sharing usernames or passwords, and redistributing protected third-party data without the required written consent.
Koyfin publishes its current privacy policy for the website and mobile applications and describes account, profile, usage, and subscription data handling.
